title: A Vision of Joshua the High Priest

questions.question: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord, and... standing at his right hand to accuse him.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:1 (ESV): "and Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him."

questions.question: And the Lord said to Satan, "The Lord rebuke you, O Satan! The Lord who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Is not this a brand plucked from the...?"
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:2 (ESV): "Is not this a brand plucked from the fire?"

questions.question: What kind of garments was Joshua wearing when he was standing before the angel?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:3 (ESV): "Now Joshua was standing before the angel, clothed with filthy garments."

questions.question: And the angel said to those who were standing before him, "Remove the..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:4 (ESV): "Remove the filthy garments from him."

questions.question: What did the angel say to Joshua after the filthy garments were removed?
options: "Behold, I have taken your iniquity away from you."
"You are now clean in my sight."
questions.correctAnswer: "Behold, I have taken your iniquity away from you."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:4 (ESV): "And to him he said, 'Behold, I have taken your iniquity away from you, and I will clothe you with pure vestments.'"

questions.question: Then I said, "Let them put a clean... on his head." So they put a clean... on his head and clothed him with garments.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:5 (ESV): "Then I said, 'Let them put a clean turban on his head.'"

questions.question: And the angel of the Lord solemnly assured Joshua, "Thus says the Lord of hosts: If you will walk in my ways and keep my charge, then you shall rule my house and have charge of my..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:7 (ESV): "then you shall rule my house and have charge of my courts,"

questions.question: "Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, you and your friends who sit before you, for they are men who are a..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:8 (ESV): "for they are men who are a sign:"

questions.question: "Behold, I will bring my servant the..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:8 (ESV): "behold, I will bring my servant the Branch."

questions.question: "For behold, on the stone that I have set before Joshua, on a single stone with..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:9 (ESV): "on a single stone with seven eyes,"

questions.question: "I will engrave its inscription, declares the Lord of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of this land in a..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:9 (ESV): "and I will remove the iniquity of this land in a single day."

questions.question: "In that day, declares the Lord of hosts, every one of you will invite his neighbor to come under his..."
options: Vine and under his fig tree
questions.correctAnswer: Vine and under his fig tree
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:10 (ESV): "every one of you will invite his neighbor to come under his vine and under his fig tree."

questions.question: Who stood by while they clothed Joshua with garments and put a clean turban on his head?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:5 (ESV): "And the angel of the Lord was standing by."

questions.question: In addition to ruling the Lord's house and courts, what else did the Lord promise Joshua if he walked in His ways?
options: "I will give you the right of access among those who are standing here."
questions.correctAnswer: "I will give you the right of access among those who are standing here."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:7 (ESV): "and I will give you the right of access among those who are standing here."

questions.question: What do the "filthy garments" represent as they are taken off Joshua?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 3:4 (ESV): "Behold, I have taken your iniquity away from you,"

key_verse_text: And the angel said to those who were standing before him, "Remove the filthy garments from him." And to him he said, "Behold, I have taken your iniquity away from you, and I will clothe you with pure vestments."
